# REQ: LANG-771 LANG-772 LANG-773 LANG-774
function greet --argument-names name times
    # Greets the name.
    set -l text "Hello, $name!\n"
    for i in (seq $times)
        echo $text
    end
end

set -gx PATH $HOME/bin $PATH
if test (count $argv) -gt 0; and not set -q DEBUG
    greet $argv[1] 2
else if string match -q 'a*' -- $USER
    echo 'single $not' | string upper
end
switch $status
    case 0
        echo ok
    case '*'
        return 1
end
